learning_outcomes.text: be aware of today’s working life requirements
be inspired to adopt self-leadership tools
understand situational requirements in communications regarding formality, emotion and assertiveness
feel more comfortable presenting in public and defending one’s views in dialogue
master collaboration strategies relevant to teamwork, group dynamics and external stakeholders

syllabus_topics: Awareness of competence requirements in working life
Trends urging university graduates to hone their metaskills
Setting goals for students’ professional growth
Responsiveness in dialogue (through simulations and reactive exercises)
Dialogical skills: assertiveness, listening and empathy
Interaction skills in oral contexts (human exchange)
Interaction skills in written contexts (formality strategies, clarity, concision, coherence)
Executive summary writing (related to project work)
Teamwork abilities: managing tasks in collaboration and exchanging feedback on individual performance
